theories.claim: QA shard/theory dispatch validation allows dot-containing identifiers to reach QA use cases instead of returning 400 invalid_request
theories.basis: handlers.go dispatch loop (421-436) validates all non-artifact params with validIdentifier (identifierPattern ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$ allows '.'); artifact routes use validOpaqueRef (^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$ forbids '.'). QA routes sprint_qa_shard, sprint_qa_theory, api_sprint_qa_shard, api_sprint_qa_theory, api_sprint_qa_evidence, api_sprint_qa_issue are not artifact routes, so shard/theory values like 'qa-v1-shard.evil' or 'foo.bar' pass generic check and are forwarded to handleSprintQAShard/QATheory (qa_handlers.go:129-152) with no additional handler-side gate before app.QAQueries.
theories.verification_surface: internal/web/handlers.go:22-23,421-436,1047-1054 dispatch validation + routeMatch QA branches; internal/web/routes.go:337-382 QA route definitions (splitPath, no inline regex); internal/web/qa_handlers.go:129-152 direct pass-through; expectation refs contract-errors (400 invalid_request for invalid resource identifier) and contract-security (strict loopback input validation)
theories.confirmation_condition: A request to /api/v1/projects/alpha/sprints/30-web/qa/shards/shard.evil or /theories/theory.bad (dot in id) is routed as known, passes dispatch validIdentifier, reaches QA use case and returns non-400 (e.g., 422 qa.invalid_state or 500) instead of 400 {code:invalid_request} at the handler boundary
theories.refutation_condition: Dispatch uses validOpaqueRef (or QA-specific pattern requiring ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$ and no dot) for shard/theory/evidence/issue params, causing same request to be rejected in dispatch writeRouteError 400 invalid_request without reaching QA use case
theories.inconclusive_condition: Static file view confirms generic pattern but cannot execute handler to observe live status code; downstream sprint Service may re-validate and still return 400/404, masking handler permissiveness, or MaxIdentifierBytes length checks may already dominate
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read-only file inspection: read handlers.go identifierPattern/opaqueRefPattern and dispatch loop to confirm branch condition strings.Contains(match.name,"artifact"); read routes.go matchRoute to confirm QA param indices have no regex; grep validIdentifier/validOpaqueRef usages; inspect qa_handlers_test.go and routes_test.go TestAPIValidationAndIdentifierBoundaries for absence of QA dot-rejection coverage; compare artifact vs QA validation paths

theories.claim: Evidence/issue focused QA query identifiers share same permissive dispatch, allowing invalid evidence/issue ids to reach adjudication path
theories.basis: api_sprint_qa_evidence (9 parts /qa/evidence/{id}) and api_sprint_qa_issue (9 parts /qa/issues/{id}) also matched in routes.go:379-382 and validated only via validIdentifier in handlers.go dispatch. app layer validateFocusedQARequest (sprint_usecases.go:938-953) only checks allowed field presence, not identifier syntax, and evidence/issue ids canonically are opaque refs (e.g., evidence digests, issue ids) which should be ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$ without dot.
theories.verification_surface: internal/web/handlers.go dispatch loop applied to api_sprint_qa_evidence/issue; internal/web/routes.go:379-382; internal/app/sprint_usecases.go validateFocusedQARequest and QAEvidence/QAIssue handlers
theories.confirmation_condition: Request to /api/v1/projects/alpha/sprints/30-web/qa/evidence/bad.evil or /qa/issues/bad.evil passes dispatch and reaches QAEvidence/QAIssue returning 422/404 instead of handler 400 invalid_request
theories.refutation_condition: Dispatch applies validOpaqueRef to evidence/issue param positions, rejecting dot-containing values with 400 before QA use case
theories.inconclusive_condition: No read-only execution; existing tests (qa_handlers_test.go) use valid ids only and routes_test only covers /api/v1/validations and artifact '..', leaving QA evidence/issue boundary unexercised in visible fixtures
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Inspect routes.go param mapping for evidence/issue, inspect handlers.go dispatch conditional for artifact vs non-artifact, inspect sprint_usecases.go validateFocusedQARequest to confirm no syntax check, search codebase for opaqueRef usages beyond validations scope/ref check
